mentions.note: 4 x 400 metres for New Zealand; born 25 October 1972; pb 47.31 ('94); coached by John Powell; 1993 New Zealand 400 metre Champion; ran first leg, team 6th in heat in 3:06.39

mentions.h: Area titles spread across England and Wales

mentions.note: New Zealander; selected for New Zealand's World Championship 4x400m squad; 2nd in 4th BAL match at Enfield (photo); 200m 22.1; 400m 47.49; 4x400m relay 3:13.62

photos.c: Hitting the Belgrave Rankings for the first time, New Zealander Callum Taylor, gained selection for his country's World Championship 4x400m squad. Callum is pictured on his way to 2nd in the 4th BAL match at Enfield.
